title: Fra Angelico’s Earliest Altarpiece Returns to Fiesole after Repair and Cleaning
summary: Fra Angelico’s Fiesole Altarpiece, made between 1420 and 1423, has been returned to its original setting at the convent of San Domenico following a lengthy restoration. The two-year process, funded by the cultural-preservation nonprofit Friends of Florence, rehabilitated the work from a prior sixteenth century restoration, and repaired the altarpiece’s painting as well as wooden support.
